fieldValues.title: Retire 5 more subsection records via succession (RFC-042 Change B, srs#710)
fieldValues.summary: Finalized Supporting types, ext:type-inheritance, Vocabulary and Term, Field, Record tiers under rfc-decision-1e7c0c8e: 14 orphaned example/table leaves reparented to their siblings' shared concept, meta.derivedFrom set on all 33 successors, then record delete --cascade on all 5 subsections. Container membership drift fixed via srs container members add/remove. Also fixed a stale RFC-030 manifest citation and created a missing ext:type-inheritance extension shadow record that check-rfc-integration.mjs needed.
fieldValues.body:
Claimed 2026-09-11T~05:2xZ from srs#710's gate:dispatched via srs#580's queue (scheduled programme routine). Ground re-measured current state on a fresh, unshallowed worktree off origin/master (a96c417): 1 section record remained (Key Invariants, deliberately deferred) and 50 subsection records. Cross-referenced every subsection's inbound derived-from edges against its outbound contains edges (per carried-context-87e8e448) and found 12 already-migrated subsections (with successor mechanisms) still carrying orphaned example/table leaves. Picked 5 of the 12 for this batch: Supporting types (3 orphans), ext:type-inheritance (3), Vocabulary and Term (1), Field (2), Record tiers (3) -- 12 total leaves, chosen for a clean 1:1 or shared-concept mapping to keep the PR reviewable.

For each orphan, identified the correct target concept by title/content match against sibling mechanisms already properly parented (e.g. 'The `ValidationRule` shape' example matches the `ValidationRule` mechanism, both belonging under the `Validation` concept). Fix: relation create contains (concept -> leaf), relation create derived-from (leaf -> old subsection), record update meta.derivedFrom on every successor (33 total: existing mechanisms + reparented leaves, none had it yet), then record delete --cascade per subsection.

Container-membership fallout: several reparented leaves' target concepts live in a different Part than the old subsection (e.g. two Record tiers leaves move Foundations -> Instances, one moves Foundations -> Structure; three ext:type-inheritance leaves move Extensions -> Foundations since Type specialisation lives there; one Supporting types leaf moves Foundations -> Conformance since Validation lives there). Fixed via srs container members add/remove per the CLI-only rule; part-container-membership.mjs --check is clean (9/9 match).

Two findings fixed in the same change, per carried-context-c4e43a58's grep-first guidance: RFC-030's manifest cited stale subsection:field / subsection:vocabulary-and-term tokens, re-pointed to mechanism:field / mechanism:vocabulary-and-term (their exact-title successors). More significantly: ext:type-inheritance had no dedicated com.semanticops.spec/extension shadow record like its ten siblings (ext:lifecycle, ext:changelog, etc) -- it only ever resolved check-rfc-integration.mjs's ext: token via the subsection's own ext:-prefixed title. Deleting the subsection broke RFC-020 and RFC-040's ext:type-inheritance token (caught by a real validate-all red run, not assumed). Fixed by creating the missing shadow record (retirement-stub content, same pattern as the other ten) plus a publication-reachability-exclusions.json entry. Checked the remaining 45 subsections for the same gap: ext:protocol, ext:repository, ext:federation are also ext:*-titled with no shadow record, but none is currently cited inside an actual srs-integration manifest block, so no active breakage -- harvested as carried_context for whoever retires one of those three.

Both gates verified green by direct exit code (not piped through tail, per the shallow-clone/output-tail traps in CLAUDE.md): validate-all.mjs (failed twice first -- once on the RFC-integration break, once on a heading-restatement false positive in my own new extension record's content field caused by firstSentence() not terminating at a bolded lead-in's period -- fixed both, then green) and check-release-drift.mjs, after publish-spec.mjs re-rendered docs/spec/** with the pinned CLI (v0.1.0-build.372).

Remaining for srs#710: Key Invariants (no successor, carried-context-31ea3659), 45 more subsection records (7 of the remaining 12 already-migrated-with-orphans subsections still need this same treatment), and the final srs type delete PR once both counts hit zero.

PR: https://github.com/the-greenman/srs/pull/749, gate:auto-merge armed (SQUASH). Stopping per the merge-rights contract.
